Subject: Records request automation for the Caddo Springs city clerk

Hi Ms. Whitfield,

I direct public sector sales at MuniVault Systems. We build document AI
for city clerks: our platform reads incoming public information
requests, locates the responsive records, and drafts redactions for
staff review. We have been serving Texas cities since 2015.

On compliance and procurement, we come ready:

- TX-RAMP Level 2 certified, so Texas agencies can deploy us without a
  separate security assessment.
- GovRAMP Authorized at the Moderate impact level.
- Available on Texas DIR cooperative contract DIR-CPO-4987; your
  purchasing office can buy directly with no new solicitation.
- Headquartered in Round Rock, Texas, with 41 full-time employees.

Current customers include the City of Sabine Ridge, the City of Llano
Vista, and Kestrel County. Sabine Ridge cut its average response time
on records requests from nine days to two within the first quarter.

Do you have 25 minutes next week? I would be glad to walk through the
redaction workflow live on a sample request.
